source_summary: A muted ink-and-wash Chinese winter landscape with misty diagonal mountains, sparse bare trees, dark pine clusters, a lower-left hamlet with small travelers, layered foreground banks, and a quiet waterside area at the right.

motifs.name: upper_left_misty_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the pale upper-left mountain cliff face, including its rounded summit, dark broken contour along the top and right edge, faint internal slope lines, and the small dark pine and bare-tree cluster growing on the cliff ledge.
must_preserve: soft tan-green wash of the cliff face
irregular dark ink contour on the summit and descending edge
tiny clustered pine needles and sparse bare branches on the slope

motifs.name: diagonal_middle_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the broad misty mountain slope descending diagonally from the upper middle toward the right, with its ink-dark ridgeline, pale wash body, and small scrub marks along the ridge.
must_preserve: subtle graded wash fading into mist
small dark shrub dots along the ridge
thin exposed branch marks on the slope edge

motifs.name: distant_right_low_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the faint low mountain ridge on the middle-right horizon, including the delicate wavering outline and pale wash below it.

motifs.name: left_overhanging_bare_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the leafless tree projecting from the left bank into the open mist, with its twisted trunk, horizontal branch, dangling twig strokes, and dark shrub mass at the base.
must_preserve: dark stippled shrub texture at the base

motifs.name: lower_left_hamlet_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left village and pavilion cluster built into the hillside, including sloped roofs, vertical wall posts, small railings, terraces, and the path-like bank around the buildings.
must_preserve: faint warm wash on walls and roofs

motifs.name: left_gate_traveler_pack_animal
motifs.description: Isolate the small activity group at the lower-left edge: the simple gate or fence structure, tiny standing figures, and the small pack-animal form with light color accents beside the path.

motifs.name: central_pine_bare_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground grove in the lower center-right, combining dark pine trunks and needle masses with taller bare branches and surrounding shrub texture.
must_preserve: leafless branch networks rising above the pines
varied ink density from dry brush to dark wash

motifs.name: foreground_layered_banks_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the sweeping foreground land and stream-bank forms across the bottom, including layered contour lines, exposed rock ledges, low mounds, and reed or grass tufts at the lower right.
must_preserve: pale wash transitions suggesting shallow water or damp ground

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
